fields.description: Issue includes editorial commentary on a Dade County grand jury investigation and allegations of corruption involving local public-safety and police officials, with discussion of bribery and courthouse proceedings. Features an open letter addressed to Postmaster General James A. Farley concerning his stay at the Miami Biltmore Hotel and political optics. Contains local columns and nightlife coverage (including Torch K-9 Club), discussion of the National Housing Act with remarks by an FHA district director, and extensive entertainment, bar/restaurant, and racing-related content including Hialeah Park tips and advertisements.
